retail_vs_institutional_positioning.retail_positioning_summary: Retail sentiment across Reddit (r/stocks, r/wallstreetbets) and X/FinTwit is cautiously bullish (74/100). Retail investors frequently praise Qualcomm's valuation at ~16.5x forward earnings compared to NVIDIA and ARM, citing Snapdragon 8 Elite benchmarks and positive battery reviews on Snapdragon Copilot+ laptops. Traders debate potential long-term risks if Apple successfully transitions internal modems in 2026-2027, but view automotive growth and dividend stability as supportive valuation backstops. Retail options flow shows steady accumulation of November $170 and $175 calls, with a Put/Call Open Interest ratio of 0.79x.
retail_vs_institutional_positioning.institutional_positioning_summary: Institutional positioning is neutral-to-constructive. 30 covering Wall Street analysts maintain a consensus Hold/Buy rating (2.57 recommendation mean) with an average price target of $196.30 (+16.95% upside from $167.85 spot; median PT $180.00, high PT $400.00, low PT $100.00). Sell-side desks from Bernstein, Morgan Stanley, and KeyBanc view Q4 FY26 as a pivotal transition quarter ahead of the Snapdragon 8 Elite handset launch cycle and PC volume inflection in 2027. In the options market, the Nov 06 weekly ATM straddle prices a ±9.00% move (±$15.10/sh on 96.50% IV), which is +1.54% higher than Qualcomm's 4-quarter average realized move of ±7.46%, setting up an attractive theta-decay or volatility harvesting opportunity for market-neutral hedge funds.
